name: Shakti lucid-dream series: session 6, frontal
origin: Todd Murphy, 8 Coil Shakti (pattern drawn from user reports)
summary: Session 6 of Murphy's lucid-dreaming series: after five temporal sessions, the same amygdala and hippocampal signals in sequence over the frontal lobes. Murphy says lucid dreaming 'is most likely to be reported' with this pattern, on the strength of 'a few Shakti reports' and no laboratory study.
setting: Run it in the evening of the night you want to dream: the vendor says most sessions behind its dream reports 'were done shortly before sleep'. Dark, quiet room, eyes closed.
schedule: Once, after the five sessions of murphy-shakti-lucid-dream-series-temporal; then the vendor's 21-day break. The vendor gives only this order: a week between sessions is this project's choice within the vendor's general rules. Murphy says effective temporal sessions are 'probably ... a prerequisite', so do not start the series with this file.
notes: The vendor gives the order only: 'five Shakti sessions over the temporal lobes, with the sixth (and last) in the series being the frontal lobe session' (lucid_dream.htm, with a four-coil photo). Its 8-coil version of this signal asks for four coils over each eye and exists only with fast or slow alternation between its two stereo channels, fast being a switch every half second (8_coil_amy_hip_in_sequence_consent.htm). This program plays 30 min on four frontal coils (Fp1, AF3, Fp2, AF4), all together, without alternation; the other four channels stay silent. The 30 min, the sites and the two coils per side are this project's choices. One cycle lasts 9.4 s: amygdala 0.69 s, silence 4 s, hippocampus 0.74 s, silence 4 s. The amygdala signal is the project's rising sweep (6 to 30 Hz) with the published point duration and length (230 points of 3 ms); the point values were never published as numbers (the lab prints the shape only as a small figure). The hippocampal stand-in is the primed burst: one pulse, then four pulses 170 ms later, three times in 0.74 s (after Tsang 2004 p.5 [1017]). Both are rebuilt from descriptions: the vendor's files are not published. Field strength: the vendor gives 10 to 20 mG without saying where it is measured (mono_proposal.htm, 'Formal Discussion'). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. Support: 'There have been no laboratory studies about it, but there have been a few Shakti reports' (dreaming.htm, LUCID DREAMING). Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Headache or pressure with hippocampal signals (vendor: about 2% of users): lower the intensity by one third. Not for people with epilepsy or a seizure history; stop at once on fear or any distress.
